size#

A role for things that know how many elements they hold.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let parts is Sizing = buffer.content();
parts.size();

Description#

A role for things that know how many elements they hold.

Collections, buffers and sequences do it, so code can ask any of them the same way.
